name: Mechanical CAD Designs
shortDescription: A growing collection of 50+ SolidWorks models and assemblies created through hands-on practice.
overview: This collection documents ongoing practice in mechanical CAD, including individual components and multi-part assemblies. Models are created to improve 3D modelling skills, understand component relationships, and practise interpreting engineering drawings.
objectives: Improve accuracy and confidence in 3D modelling.
Understand how individual parts fit together in assemblies.
Build familiarity with engineering drawings and mechanical geometry.
role: Created the models and assemblies independently as practice projects.
challenges: Translating two-dimensional drawings and dimensions into a consistent three-dimensional model.
Maintaining correct part relationships and fit in assemblies.
learnings: 3D part modelling and assembly workflows in SolidWorks.
Reading dimensions and interpreting mechanical drawings.
results: More than 50 models and assemblies created to date. The collection is ongoing.
